tasks.task: Write a full App Store and Google Play listing

items.when: When you have the current listing, recent reviews and rival apps and need every field written
When you want a second take on title, description and screenshot plan to compare
When the subtitle or short description is flat, to get three versions to choose from
When the listing is drafted, to get a scored audit and what to rewrite
When a line could describe any app, to get a true, picturable rewrite

tasks.task: Build an app store keyword plan

items.when: Before rewriting a listing, to find the words real users use and map them by theme
When the keyword map must be turned into name, subtitle and keyword field
When reviews are sorted by stars, to pull what each rating group praises and blames
When you want the app's own phrases sorted and the one want users share
When you need rival apps set against yours, with the gaps to act on

tasks.task: Plan screenshot captions and a preview video

items.when: When screenshots need captions and a frame order that tell one story, plus a video outline
When the app runs locally and you need sharp captures to build the frames from
When screenshots should become a short walk-through video or GIF
When the first caption is weak, to get five short lines that each take a new angle
When a frame is drafted, to see where the eye lands and what to cut

tasks.task: Plan store page tests and custom pages

items.when: For a stale listing, a new feature, a new country or good ratings with few installs
When you need one-change tests and audience pages planned for both stores
When a test idea is vague, to cut it to one change and what each result would mean
When each test needs a readiness check before and an honest verdict after
When a store test ends, to decide whether to trust it and state the lift as a range

tasks.task: Localise a listing for a new country

items.when: When the keyword map must be rebuilt in the words that country's users search
When listing text needs a natural translation with local tone and steady terms
When the app itself still has hard-coded text and the listing would promise too much

tasks.task: Write release notes and What's New text

items.when: When a feature ships, to set the message, the rollout steps and the support prep
When you have the real changes and need plain notes users can read
When the first line is dull, to get three versions worth reading
When the notes say bug fixes and improvements, to make them say what changed

tasks.task: Write an in-app event card

items.when: When something real and timed happens in the app and the store can feature it
When the event name is flat, to get five short options
When the card is vague about what the user gets, to make it specific

tasks.task: Plan Apple Ads search campaigns

items.when: Before launch or a restructure, to plan keyword groups and custom page ad variations
When you must say how much spend a keyword test needs before it shows a winner
When setting bids, to work out the most an install or subscriber can cost

tasks.task: Plan paid install campaigns on social

items.when: When choosing between Meta and TikTok and you need the funnel, audiences and budget
When TikTok is the first channel and you need set-up fixes and a first test read
When install ads need primary text, hooks and creator scripts to test
When you want four script types for a demo video, each with its opening
When results are in by ad, to call keep, leave or replace

tasks.task: Build a lifecycle message map

items.when: For a new app with no plan, users going quiet in week one, or people turning pushes off
When you need each moment mapped: trigger, audience, timing, cap, goal and stop rule
Before the map, to find the loop that brings users back and its weak steps
When messages need triggers and the app does not record the right events yet
When the plan pushes everyone the same way and ignores who returns on their own

tasks.task: Write a set of push notifications

items.when: When the map is agreed and each push needs copy in two versions
When a push title is flat, to try several short angles
Before a set goes live, to catch nagging or false urgency and get a clean version

tasks.task: Write in-app banners, pop-ups and tooltips

items.when: When the message belongs inside the app at the moment of use
When new users must learn a few things and need a short tour with triggers
When buttons, empty states and toasts need a friendly, clear voice
When a banner line is forgettable, to get three versions
When a pop-up pushes an upgrade, to check each lever is true

tasks.task: Write the notification permission screen

items.when: Before the system prompt, to write the pre-prompt screen and pick the moment to show it
When you must decide where the ask sits in the first minutes
When the ask is bland, to get three ways to say what the user gains
Before shipping, to check the screen promises only what notifications will deliver

tasks.task: Write a re-engagement series for quiet users

items.when: When users have gone quiet and need real reasons to return, with a clear stop
Before writing, to find why users drop off so the series answers it
When quiet users cannot be reached by push and the series must run by email
When the first message is drafted, to try several openings
Before the series is written, to plan three different arcs for quiet users and draft each first message
Before the email version sends, to score it and cut what drags
When the three arcs are drafted, so someone who did not write them picks one to finish

tasks.task: Improve first-run onboarding and activation

items.when: When you need the first run, the habit loop and one metric looked at together
When the path to first value is slow and needs a checklist, empty states and emails
When the first minutes need steps with skip options and drop-off checks
When the onboarding text no longer matches the screens users see
Each week, to see where new users stall in the first 30 days
When nobody has asked which users would truly miss the app and why

tasks.task: Read retention and find where users drop

items.when: When there is no event plan and no retention view yet
When you have activity data and need retention curves by sign-up group
When the owner needs retention shown as a simple colour grid
Before sharing the read, to check the method, the sums and any bias

tasks.task: Reply to app reviews and triage low ratings

items.when: When one to three star reviews pile up, to rank the risks and what to fix first
Before replying, to see the real reason behind each review
When each review needs a specific reply with risky ones flagged
When the batch is large, to check every reply and flag repeat complaints

tasks.task: Design the paywall and upgrade prompts

items.when: When the price itself is in doubt, to plan a survey before designing the screen
When you know the plans and need upgrade screens, trigger moments and copy
When you want a second design of the upgrade moments to compare
When subscribers cancel, to plan the cancel flow and save offers
Before shipping the paywall, to check its urgency and claims are true

tasks.task: Plan referral and growth loops

items.when: When you need the loops that fit the app ranked, and how to start the first
When users should invite friends and you need the reward and the flow
When the app only works with many users and must win one small group first

tasks.task: Plan an app or feature launch

items.when: When a launch needs timing, channels and announcement copy
When the app should be listed on launch sites and directories, with text to submit
When the launch is real news and needs a media list and pitch emails
Before launch day, to check signing, the go or no-go list and a staged rollout

tasks.task: Turn reviews and surveys into fixes

items.when: When reviews, tickets and survey answers must become ranked themes with quotes
When you have ratings and open comments and need themes and trends

tasks.task: Write the app landing page

items.when: When ads and press send people to a page that must earn the install
When the page opening is weak, to get five headlines with a pick
Before the page is written in full, to build three different first screens and compare them on a phone
When the page is live, to rank where visitors leak and what to test
When the three first screens are side by side, so a fresh reviewer picks the one to build out

always.when: Before a listing or ad states a ranking, a user count or an award, to check it traces
Before store text is submitted, to catch typos and feature names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When deep links, the permission prompt or message triggers must be built into the app
When onboarding or the paywall needs a redesigned flow, not only new words
When retention and funnel questions need event data analysed properly
When a listing or message set must be localised by a native speaker
When paid installs on TikTok need a buyer to run and tune them
When screenshots, the icon or the feature graphic must be designed

gaps: No library item writes push notifications to length limits with deep link, timing and frequency cap; only the kit does
No library item writes a notification permission pre-prompt or picks the moment to ask
No library item does app store keyword research with volume and difficulty, or packs the Apple keyword field
No library item plans Apple product page tests, Google Play listing experiments or custom product pages; only the kit does
No library item plans Apple Ads search campaigns or Google App campaigns; only the kit prompt covers Apple
No library item writes an in-app event card or a promotional text line for the stores
No library item orders screenshot frames or storyboards a preview video to store specs; the screenshot item only captures
No library item decides when to show the rating prompt
No library item covers install attribution: SKAdNetwork, deferred deep links and matching ad spend to installs
No library item localises a store listing with keywords per country; only general translation exists
No library item checks a listing against the stores' metadata rules before submission
No library item drafts two differently toned replies to one hard app review
